page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m2.large is a burstable virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by a single physical Intel Xeon 8269CY CPU core running at 2.5 GHz with hyperthreading (2 vCPUs) and 35 MB of L3 cache, the system is provisioned with 4.0 GB of RAM. It features no locally attached storage, zero baseline network bandwidth, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Supported CPU instruction sets include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX512_VNNI, AES, and FMA.

Benchmark testing highlights the resource profile of this burstable configuration. The instance recorded a single-core stress-ng score of 1300.19 and a multi-core stress-ng score of 2402.69. Geekbench tests produced a single-core score of 1045.0 and a multi-core score of 1850.0. Memory performance showed uncached read bandwidth of 20.68 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 16.39 GB/sec. Application testing yielded 2.57 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 2.44 GB/sec.

The burstable CPU model offers cost efficiency for workloads that operate with low baseline CPU utilization and occasional demand spikes. Benchmark results consistently place CPU and memory throughput in the lower performance brackets. The absence of local storage and baseline network bandwidth requires reliance on external network volumes and variable traffic. Recommended use cases include low-traffic web applications, staging environments, basic microservices, and lightweight background processing.
